text:
Ana: Quick heads-up — PR #31245 is ready for cross-team review. Small change touching eviction + kv-cache fallback that impacts runtime batching and platform routing. Targeting merge in tomorrow's 10:00 PT merge window if there are no blockers. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/31245

Cole: I can take runtime. Will skim now. Main things I'll look for: KV cache invalidation correctness, whether we accidentally force synchronous flushes, and perf regression tests.

Devon: Platform here — please confirm if this adds any new config keys or toggles. If so we need a config-schema update and a canary plan. If it's just behavioral, still want a short note in the PR description about routing implications.

Sam: Infra: are there any changes that could affect node memory footprints or preemption? If you have perf numbers, paste them here. I'll run a quick smoke against autoscaler in staging.

Ana: Thanks — pasted quick bench below (local perf harness):
```
# local run
./bench --scenario=kv-fallback --requests=5000
before: p50=23ms p95=120ms mem=428MB
after:  p50=24ms p95=130ms mem=431MB
```
No obvious regression on p50, small bump on p95 and +3MB memory. Tests included in PR.

Jen: Security: quick scan — not seeing any new logging of user payloads or changes to how we persist cache metadata. I'll leave a minor comment about not logging keys.

Cole: Left 2 inline comments about a potential race when invalidating the prefix cache. Added a suggestion to use the existing lock helper. Reacted with :eyes: and will re-review after fixes.

Devon: Updated the PR description with routing notes and added a follow-up commit that updates config-schema (see a01b2f). Added canary owners @dana and a brief canary plan. platform:pending until infra smoke completes.

Sam: Ran autoscaler smoke in staging and did a quick memory diff. Memory delta consistent with the bench: +3MB. No OOMs, eviction behavior unchanged. infra-approve from me.

deploy-bot: CI: all checks passed — unit tests, integration, linting. Merge queue position: 4.

Ana: Great — thanks everyone. Plan: merge tomorrow 10:00 PT if no other objections. If runtime wants a follow-up patch for the lock helper, we can land that in a separate PR and hold a short canary. Otherwise I'll queue this for merge. :rocket:

Cole: Sounds good. I'll follow up with the small lock-helper PR tomorrow morning. runtime-approve pending my follow-up. :thumbsup:

Jen: security-approve (no blocking findings).

Devon: platform-approve once Cole's follow-up is created.

Ana: Awesome — closing the loop here. Thanks all!
